segments.comment: A levitating Valkyrie wishes for lava beside the room's west wall, steps east, and fills every other free square of the level with 1000 peaceful newts (#wizgenesis stops when makemon() finds no room). A sleeping bat is then created on the only square left, the lava, and a wand of polymorph zapped west turns it into a fire ant under monpolycontrol. On the ant's move, mon.c movemon_singlemon() calls minliquid(): the fire-resistant ant burns slightly, rloc() finds no square, and deal_with_overcrowding() sends it into limbo with m_into_limbo(), so it leaves the map. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
